description:
Senior Recruiter - Tech

About Us:
Accelerate Labs is a growth-stage venture studio building AI-powered tools for enterprise software. We're scaling our team and looking for an exceptional Senior Recruiter to lead talent acquisition for engineering and product roles.

Role Overview:
You will own full-cycle recruiting for our engineering and product teams, from sourcing to offer negotiation. This is a key leadership role reporting to the VP of People Operations. You'll build and scale our recruiting processes, manage ATS workflows, and lead a team of 2-3 junior recruiters as we grow from 40 to 100+ employees over the next 18 months.

Key Responsibilities:
- Lead full-cycle recruiting for engineering, product, and operations roles
- Build strong stakeholder relationships with hiring managers and executives
- Implement recruiting best practices and metrics to track hiring funnel health
- Mentor and manage junior recruiting team members
- Manage and improve ATS infrastructure and recruiting workflows
- Collaborate on employer branding and recruiting marketing initiatives

Required Experience:
- 7+ years in full-cycle recruiting, with at least 3 years in a senior or lead role
- Proven success recruiting for technical roles (engineering, product)
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- Experience with ATS systems (Workday, Greenhouse, or equivalent)
- Track record of building and scaling recruiting teams and processes
- Comfortable with ambiguity and rapid change

What We Value:
- Results-driven mentality with focus on metrics and continuous improvement
- Ability to manage competing priorities and move quickly
- Experience recruiting for growth-stage or venture-backed companies
- Experience with diversity and inclusion initiatives

Compensation & Benefits:
- Competitive salary: $130,000 - $160,000 (depending on experience)
- Equity package
- Comprehensive health insurance
- Unlimited PTO
- Remote-friendly (2-3 days/week in San Francisco office)

This is an exciting opportunity to build something meaningful and have direct impact on our growth trajectory.
